declarations.docstring: There is a complete pairwise nonisomorphic family of simple finite-dimensional representations whose endomorphism algebras form an algebra equivalent to the group algebra, and whose squared dimensions sum to the group order.

There is a complete pairwise nonisomorphic family of simple representations such that the componentwise postcomposition action on their endomorphisms yields a representation isomorphic to the specified finite-dimensional representation of the group.
There is a complete pairwise nonisomorphic family of simple representations whose dimensions index a coordinatewise group action isomorphic to the specified finite-dimensional representation.
The group algebra of a finite group over a field is semisimple when the group order is a unit in the field.
For a finite group over an algebraically closed field of nonzero characteristic relative to its order, there is a finite family of positive dimensions whose squares sum to the group order.
An auxiliary finite-dimensional representation associated with the data D.
An isomorphism between the two auxiliary finite-dimensional representations associated with D.
The representation on the family of coordinate vectors indexed by the selected finite-dimensional representations and their dimensions.
The coordinate-family action applies the group action of the representation in each indexed component.
The linear equivalence sending an indexed family of endomorphisms to its values on the standard coordinate basis.
Evaluating the endomorphism-to-coordinate equivalence at indices i and j gives the i-th endomorphism applied to the j-th standard basis vector.
The equivalence from indexed endomorphisms to coordinate vectors intertwines the corresponding group actions.
On the group-algebra element supported at g, the i-th component of the algebra equivalence is the action of g on the i-th selected representation.
The underlying linear map of the algebra equivalence intertwines the action on the group algebra with the action on the indexed endomorphism family.
A second auxiliary finite-dimensional representation associated with the data D.
The representation on the indexed family of endomorphism spaces of the selected representations.
The group action on an indexed endomorphism family is componentwise postcomposition by the corresponding representation map.
An isomorphism from the specified finite-dimensional representation of the group to the first auxiliary representation associated with D.
An isomorphism from the specified finite-dimensional representation of the group to the second auxiliary representation associated with D.
An auxiliary finite-dimensional representation constructed from a field and a finite group.
The representation of a group on its group algebra by left multiplication.
The left regular action of g on a group-algebra element x is multiplication of x by the group-algebra element supported at g.
